content:
Overview

Sighișoara is a city in Mureș with a population of 28,102. A UNESCO World Heritage site and one of Europe’s best-preserved medieval Saxon towns, the birthplace of Vlad Țepeș (Dracula), with a stunning citadel. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5a growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
